description: Multi-day hike dashboard, drawn like an instrument readout: every logged point is a dot. Each day note links its GPS track (CSV: time, lat, lon, ele_m, hr, temp_c, cloud_pct, precip_mm; the watch keeps logging overnight at camp) in `track`; Agate loads them all (rowData). Distance, speed and climb are computed here from the raw points, the sun's altitude from each point's position and time. All panels share local time (`utcOffset`, hours from UTC); camps are the dotted blocks on the speed panel. Hover the route or any panel for a reading; drag across the elevation panel to zoom the others. Click the route to open that day's note. Colours come from the Obsidian theme (`agateColors`: text for data, accent for hover and selection). The chart is as wide as the note. Route and heights: OpenStreetMap, Copernicus DEM. Basemap: USGS 3DEP multidirectional hillshade by default (keyless, US only; one image for the map frame, multiplied into the background in light mode and drawn faintly in dark mode), or static keyless tiles; needs Load remote data.

transform.calculate: isValid(datum.lat0) ? 2 * 6371000 * asin(sqrt(pow(sin((datum.lat - datum.lat0) * PI / 360), 2) + cos(datum.lat0 * PI / 180) * cos(datum.lat * PI / 180) * pow(sin((datum.lon - datum.lon0) * PI / 360), 2))) : 0

upper(format(datum.mi, '.1f') + ' mi · ' + format(datum.climb, ',.0f') + ' ft climbed · high ' + format(datum.top, ',.0f') + ' ft · ' + format(datum.moving, '.1f') + ' h moving · ' + datum.days + ' days')
atan((exp(PI * (1 - 2 * (datum.y) / pow(2, tz))) - exp(-PI * (1 - 2 * (datum.y) / pow(2, tz)))) / 2) * 180 / PI
atan((exp(PI * (1 - 2 * (datum.y + 1) / pow(2, tz))) - exp(-PI * (1 - 2 * (datum.y + 1) / pow(2, tz)))) / 2) * 180 / PI

bm === 'satellite' ? 'https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/' + tz + '/' + datum.y + '/' + datum.x : bm === 'usgs' ? 'https://basemap.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/USGSTopo/MapServer/tile/' + tz + '/' + datum.y + '/' + datum.x : bm === 'hillshade' ? 'https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/Elevation/World_Hillshade' + (agateDark ? '_Dark' : '') + '/MapServer/tile/' + tz + '/' + datum.y + '/' + datum.x : 'https://tile.opentopomap.org/' + tz + '/' + datum.x + '/' + datum.y + '.png'
asin(sin(datum.lat * PI / 180) * sin(datum.sdec) + cos(datum.lat * PI / 180) * cos(datum.sdec) * cos(datum.sha)) * 180 / PI

text.value: SUN ° above horizon · shaded = sunlight through cloud

value.expr: upper((bm === '3dep' ? 'Basemap USGS 3DEP' : bm === 'satellite' ? 'Imagery Esri, Maxar' : bm === 'usgs' ? 'Basemap USGS' : bm === 'hillshade' ? 'Basemap Esri, USGS' : 'Map © OpenStreetMap, OpenTopoMap') + ' · trail © OSM contributors · Copernicus DEM · Open-Meteo ERA5 · shower invented · not for navigation')
